pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Out-of-tree DRM/KMS kernel driver for the MCT "T6 USB Station" chipset, as in the StarTech USB32HDES USB 3.0 to HDMI adapter (USB ID 0711:5601): display up to 1920x1200 at 60 Hz, hardware cursor, gamma table and HDMI audio as an ALSA sound card.
This package builds the module from source with linux-mod-r1 (signed when the kernel's module signing is set up) and also installs the trigger6-fast helper, which converts the desktop picture to NV12 with libyuv for about 60 instead of 29 frames per second, plus the udev rule and the systemd user service that start it when the adapter appears.
